subject: Supabase production migration identity reconciliation
symptom: A migration-lineage repair branch correctly identified production/Git timestamp drift but accumulated unrelated stale quality-surface changes while protected main moved, making the branch unsafe as the canonical merge candidate.
rootCause: Two independent concerns were mixed: immutable production-ledger identity reconciliation and unrelated test/quality-surface repairs. Because migration identity is source/provenance reconciliation rather than semantic DDL work, expanding the repair scope increased stale-branch and moving-main risk without improving production truth.
failedApproach: Continue extending or forcing a stale reconciliation branch through after unrelated scope has accumulated, even when one subset of the branch remains technically correct.

provenFix.strategy: Start from current protected main, transplant only the still-valid migration-identity delta, reuse the exact existing SQL blobs under production ledger identities, remove stale aliases, run protected gates, merge with exact-head protection, then read back Git main and live Supabase migration history.

evidence: Git main readback contains exact production identities
live Supabase migration history readback matches the same identities
